notes:
Beta 1.5.14 - stable badge rendering across update batches.

Fix: badge icon flickered on/off ("через раз") because Telegram’s incoming update batches replaced our patched cached Chat/User objects. Now ProcessUpdatesWearHook also re-runs the server-badge cache patch after each update batch, and the poll interval was tightened from 5s to 2s so freshly-cached chats pick up the badge faster.
